description: Flat metadata schema for bacterial single amplified genomes generated from soil samples using whole genome amplification, next-generation sequencing, and genome assembly.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for the metadata record for one bacterial SAG dataset entry.

sample_id.descr: Unique identifier assigned to the soil sample from which the SAG was derived.

sag_id.descr: Unique identifier assigned to the single amplified genome or reconstructed genome record.

project_name.descr: Name of the project or study generating the SAG data.

sample_source_type.descr: Source material for the record; expected value: soil.

soil_environment_type.descr: Broad soil ecosystem type, e.g. forest soil, agricultural soil, grassland, tundra, desert.

sample_site_name.descr: Name of the collection site, field location, plot, or station.

latitude.descr: Latitude of sample collection site in decimal degrees (WGS84).

longitude.descr: Longitude of sample collection site in decimal degrees (WGS84).

elevation_m.descr: Elevation of the collection site above sea level in meters.

country.descr: Country where the sample was collected.

administrative_region.descr: State, province, or equivalent administrative region of the sample site.

collection_date.descr: Date of sample collection in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD).

collection_time.descr: Local time of collection if available, in 24-hour format (HH:MM:SS).

collector.descr: Person, team, or organization that collected the sample.

sampling_depth_cm.descr: Depth of soil collection in centimeters below the soil surface.

soil_horizon.descr: Soil horizon designation, if known, e.g. O, A, B, C.

soil_texture.descr: Soil texture category, e.g. sand, loam, clay, silt loam.

soil_moisture_percent.descr: Soil moisture content as percent water by mass or defined method.

soil_temperature_c.descr: Soil temperature at collection in degrees Celsius.

ambient_temperature_c.descr: Air temperature at the collection site in degrees Celsius.

ph.descr: Soil pH measured at or near the time of collection.

organic_matter_percent.descr: Soil organic matter content as percent, if measured.

nitrogen_content_percent.descr: Total nitrogen content of soil as percent, if measured.

phosphorus_content.descr: Soil phosphorus concentration, with units specified in accompanying methods or standardized as mg/kg if used consistently.

carbon_content_percent.descr: Total carbon content of soil as percent, if measured.

salinity.descr: Soil salinity or electrical conductivity value, with units specified in methods if not standardized.

oxygen_conditions.descr: Oxygen status of the soil environment at sampling, e.g. oxic, hypoxic, anoxic.

vegetation_cover.descr: Dominant vegetation or land cover at the sampling site.

land_use.descr: Land use category, e.g. forest, cropland, pasture, urban, unmanaged.

disturbance_history.descr: Relevant site disturbance history, e.g. fire, tillage, flooding, grazing.

wga_kit_name.descr: Name of the whole genome amplification kit used, e.g. multiple displacement amplification kit brand/model.

wga_protocol_name.descr: Name or short description of the amplification protocol used.

wga_template_input_amount_pg.descr: Amount of DNA template input for whole genome amplification in picograms.

wga_reaction_volume_ul.descr: Reaction volume for whole genome amplification in microliters.

wga_incubation_temperature_c.descr: Incubation temperature used during amplification in degrees Celsius.

wga_negative_control_passed.descr: Indicates whether the negative control for whole genome amplification showed no detectable contamination.

library_preparation_method.descr: Sequencing library preparation method or kit used after amplification.

sequencing_platform.descr: Next-generation sequencing platform used, e.g. Illumina MiSeq, HiSeq, NovaSeq, Oxford Nanopore, PacBio.

sequencing_chemistry.descr: Sequencing chemistry or kit version used, if applicable.

sequencing_read_type.descr: Type of sequencing reads, e.g. single-end, paired-end, long-read.

read_length_bp.descr: Read length in base pairs for short-read sequencing, or nominal read length if applicable.

sequencing_depth_reads.descr: Total number of reads generated for this record.

raw_data_accession.descr: Primary raw sequencing accession identifier, such as SRA, ENA, or DDBJ accession.

assembly_software.descr: Genome assembly software used to reconstruct genomes from sequencing reads.

assembly_algorithm.descr: Assembly algorithm or strategy used, e.g. de Bruijn graph, overlap-layout-consensus, hybrid assembly.

assembly_version.descr: Version of the assembly software used.

assembly_parameters.descr: Key assembly parameters or command-line options used, recorded as a free-text string.

contig_count.descr: Number of contigs in the final assembly.

assembly_size_bp.descr: Total size of the assembled genome in base pairs.

gc_content_percent.descr: GC content of the assembled genome as a percentage.

completeness_percent.descr: Estimated genome completeness percentage, if assessed.

contamination_percent.descr: Estimated genome contamination percentage, if assessed.

binning_used.descr: Indicates whether genome binning was used during genome reconstruction.

taxonomic_assignment.descr: Taxonomic identification or assignment of the SAG, preferably at genus or species level when available.

taxonomic_method.descr: Method used for taxonomic assignment, e.g. marker gene analysis, GTDB-Tk, BLAST.

functional_annotation_pipeline.descr: Pipeline or software used for functional annotation of the genome, if performed.

functional_potential_summary.descr: Brief summary of inferred functional capabilities relevant to soil nutrient cycling, recorded as text.

nitrogen_cycle_genes_present.descr: Indicates whether genes associated with nitrogen cycling were detected.

carbon_cycle_genes_present.descr: Indicates whether genes associated with carbon cycling were detected.

phosphorus_cycle_genes_present.descr: Indicates whether genes associated with phosphorus cycling were detected.

ecological_role_notes.descr: Free-text notes on the expected ecological role of the bacterium in soil ecosystems.

curation_status.descr: Metadata curation status, e.g. submitted, reviewed, validated.
